panels.title: SRF Download group by source code

targets.expr:
sum by (source_code, filial_id, source_type) (
  increase(srf_ftp_connection_time_seconds_sum{application_name="download", host_name=~"$host_name", source_code=~"$source_code", filial_id=~"$filial_id", source_type=~"$source_type",}[$__interval]) /
  increase(srf_ftp_connection_time_seconds_count{application_name="download", host_name=~"$host_name", source_code=~"$source_code", filial_id=~"$filial_id", source_type=~"$source_type",}[$__interval])
)

sum by (source_code, filial_id, source_type) (
  increase(srf_transfer_time_seconds_sum{application_name="download", host_name=~"$host_name", source_code=~"$source_code", filial_id=~"$filial_id", source_type=~"$source_type", transfer_type="alarm.processing"}[$__interval]) /
  increase(srf_transfer_time_seconds_count{application_name="download", host_name=~"$host_name", source_code=~"$source_code", filial_id=~"$filial_id", source_type=~"$source_type", transfer_type="alarm.processing"}[$__interval])
)
